mapper.sql: module_types.*, module_types.name AS nameOther, CONCAT(IFNULL(creator.first_name, ''), ' ', IFNULL(creator.last_name, '')) AS createdBy, CONCAT(IFNULL(modifier.first_name, ''), ' ', IFNULL(modifier.last_name, '')) AS modifiedBy
FROM module_types LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = module_types.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = module_types.modified_by
WHERE module_types.status = 1 AND module_types.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
mapper.select:
SELECT module_types.id AS id, module_types.name AS name, module_types.name AS nameOther, module_types.ordering AS ordering, module_types.status AS status, module_types.created AS created, CONCAT(IFNULL(creator.first_name, ''), ' ', IFNULL(creator.last_name, '')) AS createdBy, module_types.modified AS modified, CONCAT(IFNULL(modifier.first_name, ''), ' ', IFNULL(modifier.last_name, '')) AS modifiedBy
WHERE module_types.status = 1 AND module_types.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO module_types ( name, ordering, created, created_by, status ) VALUES ( #{request.name}, #{request.ordering}, NOW(), #{userId}, COALESCE(#{request.status}, 1) )
mapper.update: UPDATE module_types SET name = COALESCE(#{request.name}, name), ordering = COALESCE(#{request.ordering}, ordering), status = COALESCE(#{request.status}, status), modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{request.id} AND status = 1
